sheila-dunn.line: Thirty-one years I've kept Mickey's books, love. I know what every fare cost and who never paid it.

ron-kirby.line: Forty years on the docks and they finished it with a letter. Mickey gave me the door. I don't forget that.

darren-milner.line: A shape's not much to go on. Half the town could pass for that on a night like this.
